mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is increasing, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1400 thousand units (HOUST < 1400) signals weak residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is accelerating and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is declining, it signals a robust labor market that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 155000 and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) signals robust supply chain conditions that reduce inflationary pressures and support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
